items.title: Military officers behind acid attack on Indonesian activist sentenced
items.description: Four military intelligence officers are sentenced to up to three years in jail, after they threw sulphuric acid over a human rights activist in a brazen attack in Central Jakarta.

items.title: Bishop alleges 'coercive threats', 'overreach' by university regulator in resignation letter
items.description: The former ANU chancellor has accused the university regulator of "grievously" constraining her ability to do her role in a withering resignation letter tabled in parliament.

items.title: Sea drone saves US helicopter crew downed in waters near Strait of Hormuz
items.description: A look at the US Corsair sea drone used in a first of its kind mission to rescue two helicopter crew shot down near the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: High Court decision could lead to tens of millions of dollars worth of immigration claims
items.description: There are warnings a High Court ruling allowing a man to sue for false imprisonment over his indefinite immigration detention will lead to more claims running into the tens of millions of dollars.

items.title: Bear attack in Japan car park captured on CCTV as cities record more and more wild encounters
items.description: Bear encounters are rising in Japan, and the problem is not confined to the wilderness.

items.title: Woolworths to offshore hundreds of corporate jobs
items.description: Supermarket giant Woolworths will begin consultations with potentially affected staff today after announcing plans to shift some operations offshore.

items.title: 'When Neale spoke, people felt it': Daniher farewelled at MCG funeral
items.description: Family, friends, members of the AFL community and dignitaries are attending the service to remember the AFL legend, MND campaigner and former Australia of the Year.

items.title: Judge throws out appeals over homophobic tweet judgement
items.description: A Federal Court judge has dismissed an appeal against a judgement which ordered New South Wales MP Mark Latham to pay $140,000 to independent MP Alex Greenwich over a homophobic tweet in 2023.

items.title: Live: Iran attacks US navy base after US retaliates over helicopter downing
items.description: Iran says it struck the US Navy's Fifth Fleet base in Bahrain with drones following a series of US strikes on Iranian cities along the Strait of Hormuz. Follow live.

items.title: Live: NSW and federal government tension over hospital bed backlog
items.description: NSW Health Minister Ryan Park airs frustrations over the issue of people stuck in hospital beds waiting for a spot in aged care or an NDIS placement. Follow live.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
